headline: GPU rental prices flat across all six tracked GPUs; MI300X leads on price-performance at $3.62 per PFLOP-hour.
bullets: Every tracked GPU shows a 7-day change of +0%, with market indexes holding at $8.50 for B200, $5.40 for H200, and $4.62 for H100 SXM.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $3.62 per PFLOP-hour, just ahead of B200 at $3.78, but only 4 providers list it.
Hyperscaler premiums remain wide, peaking at +140% for H100 SXM ($10.68 hyperscaler vs $4.45 neocloud) and +131% for MI300X.
Marketplaces undercut other segments: Vast.ai lists H100 SXM at $2.34 and A100 80GB SXM at $1.17, while RunPod Community Cloud lists B200 at $5.98.
A100 80GB SXM is the weakest value at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour despite a low $2.70 market index.
watch: Watch whether more providers add MI300X, which currently has only 4 providers and a +131% hyperscaler premium.
